headline: NYY @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.93 at MIL 4.33, with a projected total of 9.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: NYY moved +0.91 runs while MIL moved +0.25, changing the projected margin by +0.66 runs. The projected total climbed +1.16, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: detailed start-by-start logs were not available for every starter, so the page separates actual starts from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Cody Bellinger, William Contreras, Brice Turang, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
